title: c4-issues — gh issue/milestone snapshot for the Control Room
description: Written only by `forma verify`, atomically after a live gh fetch parses cleanly. A timestamped, offline-replayable fact base — never hand-edited, never touched by `gen` or `check`.

truncated.description: Required because absence would read as fine on snapshots written before the truncation guard existed.

createdAt.description: Day the issue was opened. Optional because snapshots written before this field existed are still valid fact bases; the briefing reports history as unavailable rather than inventing it.

closedAt.description: Day the issue was closed. Absent on an OPEN issue. With createdAt, these two make the open count at any past date a derivation over one snapshot — no persistent register (I4), no second fetch.
